author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: SQUARE: ram's horn as a curved tube (outer and inner Hermite curves 8.4+ apart) from a slanted lens-shaped bell at top-left, down through a U and up a 45-degree arm to a mouthpiece end perpendicular to the arm, with a sound wave beyond the mouthpiece at the top right. Knot positions found by sampling tube clearance and U gap.
omissions: Reference's three sound waves reduced to one (the region 8+ from the mouthpiece only fits one); bell opening smaller than the reference to keep the U open.
